name: Sonnet concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Concentrated, equal-weight basket of leading AI infrastructure and platform companies expected to drive and capture the ongoing AI capex/adoption cycle through 1H26: semiconductor/compute leaders, hyperscaler cloud/AI platforms, and enterprise software beneficiaries.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This basket concentrates on the companies with the clearest, most durable exposure to AI infrastructure buildout (NVDA, AVGO, TSM, AMD for compute/silicon) and AI-monetizing platforms (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META for cloud/ads/productivity AI, PLTR for enterprise AI software, CRM for AI-enabled SaaS). These are liquid, large-cap names with strong balance sheets and visible AI-driven revenue growth, positioned to outperform a broad S&P 500 index as AI capex and adoption continue accelerating into mid-2026, while diversifying across the semiconductor and software/cloud sub-themes to reduce idiosyncratic risk within the mandate.
